records.effect: Sworn to a keep that fell three hundred winters ago. It still keeps the watch its bearer could not.
records.name: Sword

records.effect: Forged on a hill of barrow-stones, where the wind never once stopped to rest.
records.name: Great Axe

records.effect: Its head was cast from the iron of a village's last hearth. It has kept the cold out ever since.
records.name: Mace

records.effect: Cut from a thorn-oak that grew through an old battlefield. The roots remember every fallen spear.
records.name: Spear

records.effect: A gift from a widow to the man who wronged her. He wore it for a single night.
records.name: Dagger

records.effect: Taken from a white wolf that hunted the high passes alone for a hundred years.
records.name: Claws

records.effect: Strung with a hair from a storm-giant's beard. Thunder follows its arrows like a hound.
records.name: Bow

records.effect: The staff of a court sorcerer who signed decrees in fire. None were ever disobeyed.
records.name: Staff

records.effect: Lost at sea three times. Each time the tide brought it back to the same fisherman's door.
records.name: Javelin

records.effect: Worn by a pit-fighter who swore never to lose. The vow is engraved on every knuckle.
records.name: Knuckles

records.effect: It hums a single note when drawn. Those who hear it twice do not hear it a third time.
records.name: Sword

records.effect: Its bolts pass through the veil between the living and the dead, and something always follows them back.
records.name: Crossbow

records.effect: Carved from the post of a lantern that guided pilgrims home through the marsh for two hundred years.
records.name: Wand

records.effect: Its head is so thin that light passes through it. It has never once been sharpened.
records.name: Axe

records.effect: Quenched in the tears of a whole city on the day its king was buried.
records.name: Greatsword

records.effect: Carved from the rib of a young wyrm. The marrow inside it is still warm.
records.name: Javelin

records.effect: A monk's mace from a drowned chapel. Underwater, the brothers say, it still rings the hours.
records.name: Mace

records.effect: Named for the bird that sings only after dark. Its wearer hunted only after dark as well.
records.name: Claws

records.effect: Forged by a navigator-smith beneath the one star that never moves. It always points true.
records.name: Sword

records.effect: The night sky is darker where this axe has been. Astronomers have noted the gaps.
records.name: Great Axe

records.effect: Its point was set at the exact hour the sun crossed the meridian, and it remembers that light.
records.name: Spear

records.effect: Drawn from a well so deep that, at the bottom, it is always night and full of stars.
records.name: Staff

records.effect: Seven stars are set along its limbs, one for each hunter of the old constellation.
records.name: Bow

records.effect: Hammered from a star that fell on a monastery. The monks took it as an instruction.
records.name: Knuckles

records.effect: A splinter of the moon, the stories say, chipped off when the moon was younger and closer.
records.name: Dagger

records.effect: It was finished on the day the sun went dark at noon. It has never fired in full daylight since.
records.name: Crossbow

records.effect: A seraph promised a dying knight that his sword would never fall. It has never fallen, and it has never been put down.
records.name: Sword

records.effect: Blessed by seven bishops in seven cathedrals, one blessing for each of the seven sins it was made to cut away.
records.name: Greatsword

records.effect: Its point catches the first light of every morning, wherever in the world it happens to be.
records.name: Spear

records.effect: Every flange is tuned to a note of the cathedral hymn. Struck together, they sing the whole of it.
records.name: Mace

records.effect: The axe of the last high judge. It has passed one sentence a thousand times, and never once an acquittal.
records.name: Great Axe

records.effect: Strung by an angel with a single feather from her own wing. She was never seen to fly again.
records.name: Bow

records.effect: The staff that wakes the sun. Its bearer must never sleep past dawn, or the morning will be late.
records.name: Staff

records.effect: A wand of white ash cut from the tree beside the first altar. Where it points, the ground is holy.
records.name: Wand

records.effect: Thrown once into the northern sky by a giant. It came down three winters later, trailing the lights behind it.
records.name: Javelin

records.effect: Worn by a penitent who boxed in the temple yard for a hundred days. On the last day the scales balanced.
records.name: Knuckles

records.effect: Every clock in the city stopped when this was forged. They all stopped at the same hour.
records.name: Sword

records.effect: It took a thousand years to forge, one hammer-stroke each winter. The smith waited for every one.
records.name: Greatsword

records.effect: The moon on its blade never wanes. On moonless nights it is the only moon there is.
records.name: Spear

records.effect: Made by a hermit who sat beside one pond for forty years and never once saw it ripple.
records.name: Bow

records.effect: Forged at dusk in a land where dusk lasted a century. The light has not finished fading from them.
records.name: Claws

records.effect: Its head is a book whose pages fill themselves with what has not happened yet.
records.name: Staff

records.effect: An ember from the first fire was set in its haft. It has not gone out, and it never will.
records.name: Axe

records.effect: Its stock holds an hourglass that runs neither up nor down. Its bolts arrive a moment twice.
records.name: Crossbow

records.effect: Older than the mountains it cut. The valleys of the south are the marks it left while the world was still soft.
records.name: Greatsword

records.effect: The first serpent wound itself around the world to keep it warm. This spear is one of its fangs.
records.name: Spear

records.effect: Broken from the hand of a titan who held up the sky. The sky has sagged a little since.
records.name: Knuckles

records.effect: A living root of the first tree. Leaves still grow on it in spring, wherever in the world its bearer stands.
records.name: Staff

records.effect: Strung with a molten thread pulled from a falling star. Where its arrows go, the sky follows.
records.name: Bow

records.effect: Hauled from the bottom of the oldest sea, where it lay in the jaws of something that is still down there.

records.effect: Chipped from the black glass at the heart of the first volcano. It is still warm, and it still beats.

records.effect: Forged in the ash-storm that buried the first city. The storm has not stopped; it lives in the axe.
records.name: Axe

records.effect: Torn from the father of all dragons. Fire still answers them, as it answered him.
records.name: Claws

records.effect: The first flower grew from the first fire. It burned, and it bloomed, and it has never stopped doing either.
